notes:
Preparation for version 1.2.1 build 3. This production-capable build is VALID, selected for this draft, and available to the existing internal Testers group. No App Review submission has been requested yet. Build 1 is a separate internal-only sample-ad beta and is not the selected build.

This update supports applicable Google UMP regional privacy choices, optional Apple ATT/IDFA permission and permitted publisher-scoped advertising identifiers. UMP coordinates any required regional form before optional ATT. Refusing permissions leaves every tarot function available; eligibility to request an ad does not grant permission to personalize or track. Regional choices are reopened in Settings > Advertising choices. The Apple tracking choice is managed separately in iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. The app does not send readings, favorites, spread names or position labels to Google or to a developer server.

An active verified monthly subscription removes banners and ad requests. All seven existing monthly amounts remain available for changing the subscription; Apple confirms the effective change before purchase. Restore remains available. Manage Subscription now presents the native Apple sheet on iOS, supporting TestFlight sandbox cancellation or changes instead of opening the production subscriptions website. Verified entitlements are rechecked after dismissal. Cancellation does not remove an unexpired entitlement; banners return after StoreKit confirms expiry or revocation. This cancellation flow still requires checking on the physical TestFlight device. Products and prices are unchanged. No banner appears during a reading, contextual meanings or contextual tutorials.

Google Mobile Ads 12.14.0 and UMP 3.1.0 are pinned. Tarot-only English/Spanish IDFA and US-state messages are published; the existing European message is preserved. The public policy and Apple App Privacy declaration are updated. The signed archive and exported IPA include matching app/GMA/UMP privacy manifests, with tracking declared and the two reviewed advertising hosts. This evidence is a custom manifest inventory, not an Xcode-generated privacy report.

Validation: 59 Core tests, real simulator sample-banner bootstrap and six native consent/ATT cases passed before signing/upload. Six cases also passed against Tarot's published European/ATT message configuration, and a separate focused US case passed explicit opt-out, saved GPP signals, persistence after restarting and explicit reversal with persistence. Those configured-message runs cover the unchanged consent and ad-request implementation from build 2; build 3 separately corrects the subscription-management UI. No single seven-case-run claim is made. The focused US test uses sample inventory and real UI choices, not injected consent values. Physical-device QA of the distributed candidate remains for the human tester; no physical-device certification is claimed. No app account or developer login is required.
